Under the supervision of the Manager, Server and Storage Services, the Server & Storage Administrator applies professional knowledge, industry best practices, and applicable department and campus, medical center or Office of the President policies and procedures to troubleshoot and resolve systems problems of moderate complexity where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors, without impact to critical production environments. Serves as an intermediate Hypervisor Systems Administrator in support of a highly complex and critical virtual Server and Storage infrastructure. Performs routine maintenance and system updates with minimal to no instruction, with detailed instructions provided on new project and / or more complex assignments and initiatives. Within defined procedures and practices, determines appropriate action.
Adhere to OIT’s cultural values: Collaboration, Respect, Trust, Transparency, Quality, Inclusiveness, Customer Centricity, and Learning and Growth.
Must reside in California.
May be required to work overtime, as needed.
May require on call support after hours or on weekends.
Ability to elicit and communicate technical and non-technical information in a clear and concise manner.
General knowledge of new and emerging technologies such as AWS Cloud, automation and Infrastructure as Code.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Demonstrates problem-solving skills. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
Basic knowledge of how to apply technologies and systems to meet business needs.
Ability to write technical documentation in a clear and concise manner.
Understanding of system performance monitoring and actions that can be taken to improve or correct performance.
Knowledge of the design, development and application of technology and systems to meet business needs.
General knowledge of other areas of IT.
Demonstrated understanding of how system management actions affect users and dependent / related functions.
Demonstrated knowledge of computer security best practices and policies.
Ability to independently identify and resolve server and storage related issues.
Ability to stay current with technological developments in server and virtualization technologies.
Ability to attend training to acquire skills and working knowledge of emerging technologies, AWS Cloud, Automation, Infrastructure as Code.
Proficient with Hypervisor, Python, PowerShell, and JavaScript.
